title: Implicit-function chart Φ = (G, π) at a regular point (parent step 2, L2)
lean_statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ) (G : Rn (m + k) → Rn m) (D : Set (Rn (m + k))) (u₀ : Rn (m + k)), IsOpen D → u₀ ∈ D → ContDiff ℝ 1 G → Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ G u₀) → ∃ Φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph (Rn (m + k)) (WithLp 2 (Rn m × Rn k)), u₀ ∈ Φ.source ∧ Φ.source ⊆ D ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Φ Φ.source ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Φ.symm Φ.target ∧ ∀ u ∈ Φ.source, (Φ u).fst = G u
